page.content:
Orator and consul who tried to save Republican speech.

How Cicero connects

  • Faction: Roman Senate — Cicero was a consular voice of the Senate.
  • Character: Julius Caesar — Cicero defended Republican forms against Caesar's dictatorship and Antony's aftermath.

What is Cicero?

Marcus Tullius Cicero's consulship against Catiline, his Philippics against Antony, and his letters are the Republic's last great prose. Antony's proscription killed him in 43 BCE.

Key threads lead to Roman Senate and Julius Caesar.
